handelslage.leerHinweis: Reads what the next few hours have to offer — day range, events, type of movement.
handelslage.laedt: Reading and assessing the numbers of the trading day …
handelslage.hinweis: An assessment of the numbers shown, for the next few hours — not a trading recommendation. The AI only ever sees the values above; it does not research anything.
handelslage.autoTitel: Reassess by itself while a session is running. Every run costs an AI request.
handelslage.autoDeckel: Daily cap reached — button only until tomorrow
handelslage.autoNurSitzung: Only runs while a session has been started.
handelslage.info:
The tile for the trading day: what is left to be had this afternoon?
It reads different numbers than the overall situation — the day range and how much of a usual range is already used up, marks from the previous day, session VWAP, session phase, upcoming events, mechanics on 15 minutes and 1 hour, live liquidations.
It states conditions ("holds as long as …") and marks at which the reading becomes void — but no entries, exits or price targets.

ansicht.rasterSub: Free tile grid — everything equal, everything adjustable
ansicht.pultSub: Fixed instrument console — one stage, one rail, nothing adjustable

handelszeiten.title: Trading hours
handelszeiten.normal: No known timing trap — that is not a setup, just no obstacle.
handelszeiten.cmeZu: Futures market closed (CME break or weekend) — thin books.
handelszeiten.feiertagUnbekannt: Holidays unknown — without calendar data a holiday cannot be ruled out.
handelszeiten.warn_eroeffnung: US open — bad time to trade
handelszeiten.info:
Which trading session is running, and how long until the next important market mark — US open, FOMC, US close.
These windows are often the most volatile and expensive moments to enter or exit; knowing them lets you close a position deliberately before one, or open after.

sitzung.planNotizHint: What is your plan? E.g. A-setups only, no revenge trades
sitzung.notizenHint: Notes during the session — what do you notice?

indizes.title: Indices (intraday)
indizes.info:
How US equity futures and the dollar are moving right now, while crypto keeps trading.
Crypto often tracks the risk appetite of traditional markets — falling futures and a rising dollar are usually headwinds, even while the crypto price itself still looks calm.
The candles come from Yahoo Finance and only run with the "sources without sales clearance" switch (Settings › Data sources); without it the card says "off".

liq.title: Liquidations (live)
liq.uebergewicht_long: {pct} % of volume is longs — selling pressure
liq.uebergewicht_short: {pct} % of volume is shorts — buying pressure
liq.aufzeichnungAus: Recording is off — empty does NOT mean quiet here
liq.keinSammelstrom: Collector off: only individually recorded symbols deliver events.
liq.quellenHinweis: Binance throttles to one event per second per symbol — a sample, not a full count. Bybit does not throttle.
liq.bybitStill: Bybit has not delivered anything yet
liq.info:
The most recent forced liquidations in real time — what the market is flushing out right now.
A sudden burst on one side (many longs or many shorts in quick succession) often marks the exact moment a move runs out of fuel.

coinradar.title: Coin radar top 10
coinradar.leer: No completed coin radar run yet.
coinradar.korTitel: Rank correlation with the previous run: 1 = the order repeats, 0 = it changes completely. It measures persistence, not accuracy — with hourly runs it is high by construction because the candles overlap. Whether the list is any good is shown by the outcome tracking in Coin Radar → history.
coinradar.info:
The ten highest-scoring perpetuals from the last completed coin radar run. This tile only reads — it never triggers a run.
Score 0–100 from movement, participation, trend and cost; ATR is the average range of one candle of the main timeframe (default 1 h) as a percentage of price, RVOL the volume of the last candle against the average of the 20 before. Clicking a row sets the symbol for the whole window.

kalender.title: Events
kalender.allesGefiltert: {n} events in window, all excluded by your country and impact filter
kalender.info:
When the next important economic release is due, with a countdown — from the calendars of the Federal Reserve, the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and Eurostat. With the "sources without sales clearance" switch (Settings › Data sources) ForexFactory is added.
A high-impact event is a good reason not to open a new position just before it — the move afterwards is often too fast for a clean entry.

positionen.title: Positions & plan
positionen.planVerletzt: Plan exceeded — stopping would be the decision now
positionen.keinPlan: No plan set — enter limits when starting the session.
positionen.trennungHinweis: Realised is fixed, open changes on the next tick. Limits count against the realised part — otherwise the bar breaks on every pullback.
positionen.info:
How your running session stands against the plan you set beforehand.
Realised and unrealised deliberately stay separate — a floating book gain is not a result — and the loss limit counts only against the realised part, otherwise the bar would break on every pullback.

foto.hinweis: Capture this window as a screenshot into the journal (setups gallery, daily view) and make it ready to insert in Pending Trades

karten.hinweisKnopf: Every control of the bookmap and the liquidation map — the cockpit has no side menu where they would otherwise sit
karten.hinweis: Applies immediately in the tiles and on the standalone Liquidity and Liquidations pages alike — it is the same map, not a copy.

bookmap.info:
Binance's order book in real time as a heat map: where liquidity sits and where it suddenly disappears.
A wall that appears just ahead of the price and pulls away again is often not real interest but bait — liquidity that stays put once the price reaches it is more trustworthy.

hebelkarte.info:
A model of where leveraged positions would be liquidated — a map of the other side's stops.
Clusters of liquidation prices often act like a magnet: the price gets drawn toward them because triggering them creates fresh movement of its own.

kompakt.title: Compact
kompakt.info:
The side tiles of this page as one line each: trading hours, next event, mechanics, liquidations, long/short, funding, indices, Coin Radar and the two AI assessments.
Same data as the single tiles, which keep loading in the background. Click a line to open the full tile; the single tiles can be shown again under “Cards” at any time.

momentum.title: Momentum Radar
momentum.info:
A WaveTrend wave on six timeframes, cross-checked with volume-weighted money flow.
Top: the history of the chosen timeframe (dots = signals, large = higher timeframes agree, diamond = extreme, rails = signals of higher timeframes, bottom strip = 4h money flow). Below: the panel — state per timeframe, SWING and DAY setup, volume origin (spot vs futures), VWAP and 4h structure.
Computed on closed candles only. The radar says WHEN, not WHERE — the level comes from the VWAP.
momentum.herkunft_keinSpot: no spot market under this symbol
momentum.herkunft_unbekannt: not enough candles for a verdict yet
momentum.legende_punkte: DOTS: green = look for long, red = look for short. Large = at least 60 % of the counting higher timeframes plus money flow agree. Orange diamond = extreme beyond ±100, exhausted, no entry.
momentum.legende_flaeche: AREA = MONEY FLOW: green in, red out, violet = only futures drive it, the move runs on leverage. Rising while price falls means someone is accumulating.
momentum.legende_spot: WHITE LINE = spot market. Below the area: futures ran ahead. Above: spot buys harder than perps. Moving together, the move carries.
momentum.legende_schienen: RAILS (top short, bottom long): signals of the HIGHER timeframes — 1h orange and small, 4h violet, day white, week yellow and large. Bottom strip: money flow of the last closed 4h candle.
momentum.legende_linien: LINES: divergence on the chosen timeframe — price makes a new extreme, the wave does not. Fading strength, not a reversal.
momentum.legende_kopf: HEADER: the status. Up to 15m DAY applies (15m and 5m must agree), above that SWING (day/4h/1h). If it says WAIT, do nothing.
momentum.legende_wann: Computed on closed candles only, including the chosen timeframe — no preview circles, nothing that can still flip before the candle closes.

liveAuswertung.title: Evaluation
liveAuswertung.h_disziplin: Do I stick to the plan?
liveAuswertung.h_umfang: Does it turn with duration or trade count?
liveAuswertung.keinPlan: No session with limits set yet — without a plan there is nothing to keep.
liveAuswertung.duenn: Fewer than {n} sessions with a plan: the rate is still chance.
liveAuswertung.grundVerlust: {n}× loss limit broken — held on too long
liveAuswertung.medianAbweichung: The mean says {betrag} — it hangs on a few outliers; the median is the more honest figure here.
liveAuswertung.unterschied: Difference: {betrag} per session in favour of the planned ones.
liveAuswertung.vergleichZuDuenn: The comparison needs at least {n} sessions on each side.
liveAuswertung.zeitHinweis: Greyed out means: fewer than {n} sessions in this group — not yet a finding.

coinradar.bestaetigtHilfe: In play on both timeframes — not just a short-lived spike.
coinradar.dauerhaftHinweis: How often a coin was in the top ten across all {n} finished runs. What survives several runs is more than a spike.
coinradar.coinInfoKeineDaten: No project info found for {symbol} — not unusual for smaller coins.
coinradar.coinInfoKanaeleHinweis: {n} of {gesamt} common public channels listed (website, whitepaper, GitHub, X, Telegram).
coinradar.coinInfoGithubJa: Source code is publicly visible on GitHub — a sign of a visibly working team.
coinradar.einstNichtGeladen: Settings not loaded yet — changes are saved only after that.
coinradar.huerdenGekappt: Showing the {n} highest-turnover of {m} rejected coins.
coinradar.gueteTitel: Does the ranking hold up? — outcome tracking
coinradar.gueteHinweis: After 15 minutes, 1 and 4 hours the radar checks how far the top coins of a run actually moved (high minus low) — compared with a random sample from the bottom half of the same run and with a ranking by ATR% alone. If the top does not move more than the control, the ranking is noise.
coinradar.gueteLeer: No measurements yet. They are created after every run and redeemed after 15 minutes, 1 and 4 hours.
coinradar.gueteFehler: Outcome tracking could not be loaded.
coinradar.gueteLaeufeTitel: Runs with a comparable control group / all measured runs
coinradar.guetePrecisionTitel: Share of the top 10 that moved at least the threshold — averaged over runs
coinradar.gueteSpanneTitel: Median range (high minus low, in %) of the top 10 and of the control group
coinradar.gueteVorneTitel: In how many runs the top 10 moved more than the control group; p = sign test (rather optimistic, runs overlap)
coinradar.gueteRhoTitel: Rank correlation between rank and range: for the score and, for comparison, for a ranking by ATR% alone. If the score carries no more than ATR% alone, RVOL, ADX and funding add nothing.
coinradar.guete_nichtVorne: top moves no more than the control
coinradar.guete_nichtBesserAlsAtr: works — but no better than ATR% alone
coinradar.eAktivHinweis: Off by default. A run costs nothing but a small slice of the Binance budget — still, it should not run unasked.
coinradar.eEinordnungHinweis: One paragraph on the overall picture, about a cent per run. The numbers are there anyway; the sentence says what they mean together.
coinradar.eGewichteHinweis: How strongly each sub-score enters the total. The sum need not be 100 — it is normalised anyway — but 100 reads as percent.
coinradar.eHuerdenHinweis: Fail one and the coin never enters the ranking. Liquidity is a gate, not a sub-score — otherwise an illiquid jitterbug could outvote the other scores.
coinradar.eMinTiefe: Minimum at top of book (0 = off)
coinradar.eTiefeHinweis: Off by default, deliberately: top of book is only the best bid and ask size, not market depth — how large it is depends on tick size. Against real data this gate rejected pairs with over 500M daily turnover and 0.5 bp spread because 5 dollars sat at the front. Turnover and spread do the work; the value is still collected and displayed.
coinradar.eZeiteinheitenHinweis: Two levels: the coarser one carries the score, the finer one confirms or contradicts it. A contradiction is shown, not averaged away.
coinradar.einordnungQuelle: Written by a language model from the numbers above — not a forecast, not trading advice.
coinradar.laufFertig: Done: {n} coins scored, {v} failed the gates.
coinradar.nochNichtsHinweis: "Measure now" walks the tradable universe once — about fifteen seconds, at no cost.
coinradar.passtNicht: On {b} the amount does not fit the book.
coinradar.spalteAdxHilfe:
Shows whether a move is trending through or just sawing sideways.
Above 25 trend-following pays off, below 20 it usually doesn't — the same move is a ride in a trend and often a losing game in a sideways band.
coinradar.spalteAtrHilfe:
Shows whether a stop-loss entry is even worth it.
Below roughly 0.2 % per candle, costs eat the range — the coin simply isn't moving enough for a clean setup.
coinradar.spalteAusfuehrungHilfe:
How expensive an order over 5,000 USD really is, measured against the real order book.
A great opportunity score is worth little if execution eats it up — read both numbers together, never one alone.
coinradar.spalteFundingHilfe:
Shows what holding the position costs over a year.
On a long you pay when funding is positive, on a short when it's negative — high holding costs can eat the edge of a move even if the coin trades well.
coinradar.spalteNoteHilfe:
The overall opportunity score — how much is going on, combined from movement, activity, trend and holding cost.
A high score only means "something is happening here", not "you can get in and out cheaply" — that's what the execution score next to it is for.
coinradar.spalteRundlaufHilfe:
What entry and exit cost together, in basis points. For scale: BTC sits at about 0.01.
On a scalp with a small target, a high round-trip can make the whole trade unprofitable before it even runs.
coinradar.spalteRvolHilfe:
Shows whether something unusual is happening right now, compared with the coin's own normal state.
Above 2.0 a coin counts as "in play" — the basis for the filter of the same name above.
coinradar.spalteUmsatzHilfe:
How much traded in the last 24 hours.
Together with spread and depth, the basis for whether your own order would move the price by itself.
coinradar.verlaufHinweis: Every run compares its ranking with the previous one. Near 1 means it repeats — with hourly runs largely because the candles overlap. Whether the list is any good is not shown by this number but by the outcome tracking above.
coinradar.listungUnbekannt: Listing unavailable: {b}. The row stays — a source outage is no proof the coin is missing there.
coinradar.spalteBtcHilfe:
Whether the coin moves in lockstep with Bitcoin (in percent) or has a story of its own.
For a Bitcoin-based chart read, a high value is the precondition for the thesis to even transfer — at a low value, the coin moves independently of Bitcoin's next step.
coinradar.spalteBetaHilfe:
When Bitcoin moves 1 %, this coin moves β % on average.
Above 1 it amplifies a BTC move — size the position down accordingly; below 1 it dampens it.
coinradar.zerfallHilfe: Careful: the co-movement broke down within the window — first half {a} %, second half {b} %. The figure beside it averages both.
coinradar.zerfallSatz: Co-movement weakened markedly during the window. Trading on the average figure means trading on a relationship that recently stopped holding.
coinradar.btcNichtInNote: The BTC relation deliberately stays out of the score — "moves a lot", "trades cheaply" and "follows BTC" are three questions.
coinradar.boersenFilterChip: {b} — show only coins tradable there. Selecting several means "on at least one".
coinradar.spalteRangHilfe:
The placement by overall score — the list's default sort order.
Says nothing about direction, only how much is moving and how cheaply the coin trades right now, boiled down into one number.
coinradar.epWink: Measures a single symbol on demand — including ones the ranking never shows: it only covers what both Bitunix and Binance list, then filters by turnover.
coinradar.epQuelleBinanceHilfe: Same source and same calls as the ranking — the numbers are directly comparable.
coinradar.epQuelleBitunixHilfe: Binance does not list this pair. Candles, turnover, funding and order book therefore come from Bitunix.
coinradar.epNichtVergleichbar: This score sits beside the ranking, not in it: RVOL measures volume against a coin's own baseline, and a smaller exchange has a different one.
coinradar.epNichtAufBitunix: Not tradable on Bitunix. The numbers are for comparison; you cannot execute there.
coinradar.epHuerdeGerissen: Fails one of the ranking's gates ({g}) — which is why it is not listed there. It is measured here anyway, because you asked for this coin.
coinradar.epZuJung: Only {n} candles on {ze}, {min} are needed. Not enough for a score.
coinradar.epZuJungHinweis: Normal for a freshly listed coin. A number from too few candles would look like a measurement and not be one.
coinradar.epBtc_zu_jung: Too few shared candles ({n}) — the coin is too young for a one-month comparison.
coinradar.epFehler_unbekannt: None of the queried exchanges lists {s}.
coinradar.epFehler_zu_lang: That is not a trading symbol.
coinradar.epChartOeffnen: Open in the chart — prices from {q}
coinradar.ladeFehler: Ranking could not be loaded — showing the last state.
coinradar.tsHinweis: Checks the token behind the perpetual like the early phase: contract, holders, on-chain pools, project.
coinradar.tsNichtGefunden: CoinGecko does not know this coin — without a contract address there is no deep check.
coinradar.tsNichtPruefbar: No chain whose contract can be checked.
coinradar.tsOk: No knock-out traits in the contract

hypeFrueh.alleAusgeblendet: All candidates hidden. A token returns as soon as its score rises.

hypeFrueh.ladeFehler: Early phase could not be loaded.
hypeFrueh.erklaerung: Tokens before the main check (younger than 12 h or below USD 50,000 liquidity). The score measures acceleration against the token's own history, not size. At the top only the candidates, below them what you watch with the star; the full list is one click away.

hypeFrueh.kurveTitel: Still on the pump.fun bonding curve
hypeFrueh.duennTitel: Score from fewer than three of the five sub-scores — easily extreme, so sorted to the bottom and never alerted

hypeFrueh.kandidatenLeer: No token meets all conditions right now. That is normal: only a small share of young tokens is traded to any meaningful degree.
hypeFrueh.trichterSatz: Of {n} watched tokens, the first thing missing is: {teile}.
hypeFrueh.trichter_veraltet: {n} not measured in the last run
hypeFrueh.bedingung_veraltet: not measured in the last run

hypeFrueh.bedingung_handel: fewer than 20 transactions in the last hour
hypeFrueh.istKandidat: Meets every condition of a candidate
hypeFrueh.beobachtungLeer: Nothing watched yet. The star on a token adds it here — it is then measured in every run, never crowded out, and the watchdog reports by its rules, even after the early phase drops the token.
hypeFrueh.beobachtungNichtMehr: No longer in the early phase — the watchdog's last reading:
hypeFrueh.beobachtungNochKeinStand: No longer in the early phase, and the watchdog has not measured yet.
hypeFrueh.alleHinweis: The raw list: everything the early phase is measuring right now, reliable scores first. Hover over the status to see which condition for a candidate is missing.
hypeFrueh.sternAn: Watch (star) — always measured, the watchdog reports
hypeFrueh.sternFehler: The star could not be set. Please try again.
hypeFrueh.verlaufEinzeln: No history yet — only one reading.
hypeFrueh.sozialTitel: Mentioned on: {p} — {n} mentions in the last run
hypeFrueh.spalteHandelTitel: Distinct buyers / sellers in the last hour — where the source does not provide that, the number of transactions
hypeFrueh.spalteHalterTitel: Last measured number of holders (RugCheck/GoPlus, for the best of each run)
hypeFrueh.gueteTitel: Outcome tracking — does the score hit?
hypeFrueh.gueteLeer: No measurements under the rules of 10 Oct 2026 yet. Measured after 1, 3 and 7 days.
hypeFrueh.guete_zuWenig: too few pairs for a verdict (at least 10)
hypeFrueh.gueteHinweis: Every token above the threshold is compared with a partner from the same run: also reportable (contract checked, reliably measured, traded) but below the score, in the same state (curve or pool) and of similar age. Measured after 1, 3 and 7 days. "Alive" means at least 5 transactions in the last 6 hours. "Curve completed" only counts tokens still on the curve at the start. A verdict needs ten complete pairs and only stands when the exact McNemar test confirms the difference (p < 0.05). The field — a random sample of all newly seen tokens — is the base rate, not a comparison.
hypeFrueh.guete_treffer_besser: Top doubles significantly more often than its partner
hypeFrueh.guete_treffer_schlechter: Top doubles significantly less often than its partner
hypeFrueh.guete_lebt_besser: Top is significantly more often still traded
hypeFrueh.guete_lebt_schlechter: Top is significantly less often still traded
hypeFrueh.guete_kurve_besser: Top completes the curve significantly more often
hypeFrueh.guete_kurve_schlechter: Top completes the curve significantly less often
hypeFrueh.fokusFehlt: This token is no longer watched (crowded out or forgotten after three quiet days).
hypeFrueh.fokusUnbekannt: DexScreener does not know the token (any more) — no traded pair.
hypeFrueh.spurHinweis: To be honest: pump.fun, Telegram channels and Reddit were removed for licensing reasons. The trail before the first pool is narrower as a result — a token on the pump.fun curve now only appears if DexScreener or CoinGecko on-chain list it as a venue or someone mentions its contract on /biz/ or X. King of the Hill, comment count and creator record are gone.
hypeFrueh.signalKoth: King of the Hill on pump.fun after {m} min
hypeFrueh.kandidatenLeerFrei: No token meets all conditions right now. That is the normal case: only about one percent of pump.fun tokens ever completes the curve.

hypeProjekt.noteTitel: Substance score 0–100: website, domain age, GitHub
hypeProjekt.keineNoteTitel: Too little checkable for a score
hypeProjekt.info: What stands behind the token, gathered without keys: the website (sections such as roadmap and tokenomics, does it show the right contract address, placeholder text, site builder), the domain age (RDAP), the GitHub account (maintained, earlier projects with stars) (the pump.fun creator record is gone). Starts at 50, points for and against. What could not be checked (bot protection, TLD without RDAP) costs nothing. No guarantee: a good website is cheap.
hypeProjekt.erstellerBilanz: {n} other coins, {g} through the curve, {h} in the last 24 h
hypeProjekt.infoFrei: What stands behind the token, gathered without keys: the website (sections such as roadmap and tokenomics, does it show the right contract address, placeholder text, site builder), the domain age (RDAP), the GitHub account (maintained, earlier projects with stars) and for pump.fun tokens the other coins of the same wallet — creators who got one through the curve before succeed far more often than the base rate of about 1 %; those launching dozens produce mass goods. Starts at 50, points for and against. What could not be checked (bot protection, TLD without RDAP) costs nothing. No guarantee: a good website is cheap.

abverkauf.aus: Watch off — checks by hand only (switch on under settings)
abverkauf.gestartet: Pass running — the page shows the result once it is done.
abverkauf.ladeFehler: The dump watch could not be loaded.
abverkauf.e_vorwarnungTitel: Reports as soon as there is enough fuel — before it tips. More alerts, earlier, more often wrong.
abverkauf.e_anstiegTitel: From this 24h rise a perpetual enters the preselection.
abverkauf.e_umsatzTitel: Below this a short is a liquidity risk — thin books shoot both ways.
abverkauf.e_schwelleTitel: From this fuel score (0–100) a coin counts as overextended.
abverkauf.erklaerung: Coins are often pumped and then dumped. The watch scans all Binance perpetuals that rose strongly and checks two things: is there enough fuel for a dump (stretch, overheated momentum, expensive funding, freshly built open interest, long overhang, carried by futures only, freshly listed)? And is it starting (distance from the high, lower high, structure break, buying pressure gone, divergence, rejected spike, falling open interest, exhausted volume, long liquidations)? "Dump starting" is reported only when both come together and price itself confirms. Counter-signs such as new highs or strongly negative funding (many shorts, squeeze risk) block the alert. A reason to consider a short — not a forecast. Above the 24h high the reading is void.
abverkauf.leer: No coin is overextended right now.
abverkauf.noteTitel: Fuel score 0–100: how much speaks for a dump. Not a signal on its own — a coin can stay overextended for days.
abverkauf.ungueltigTitel: The 24h high: if price rises above it, the reading is void.
abverkauf.takerTitel: Taker buy/sell: the two hours before → the last half hour. Below 1 the aggressive side sells.
abverkauf.futSpotTitel: Futures turnover against spot, relative to its own weekly average. Above 1.5: the rise runs on leverage.
abverkauf.gueteTitel: Outcome tracking — did price fall after the alert?
abverkauf.gueteHinweis: Every "dump starting" alert is measured after 1, 4 and 24 hours, together with a pumped coin from the same pass that did not tip. For a short a negative return is good; "high after" is the move upwards until then — the pain a short would have had to sit through.
abverkauf.gRenditeTitel: Price change from the alert to the horizon, median. Negative = good for a short.
abverkauf.gHochTitel: Highest move upwards in the window, median.

hypeBoersen.tiefeTitel: Check contract, holders and project — by contract where known, otherwise by ticker on CoinGecko
hypeBoersen.angekuendigtHinweis: Pairs an exchange has already created but that do not trade yet — with start time where the exchange states it (Binance futures, Gate, Bitget). Once trading starts they move to the new listings.
hypeBoersen.handelsStartTitel: When the pair started trading — only Binance futures, Gate and Bitget state it; "Seen" is the compare in which it showed up.
hypeBoersen.auchAufTitel: Other watched exchanges with the same ticker. Matched by ticker, so without guarantee: for small tokens it can be a namesake.
hypeBoersen.erstauftrittTitel: The ticker is on no other watched exchange.
hypeBoersen.aus: Watching is off — compare by hand only (switch on via the gear above)
hypeBoersen.gestartet: Compare started — the page refreshes as soon as it is done.

momentum.text: Wave (WaveTrend) and money flow from the live-trading momentum radar — only 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h.
momentum.info:
Momentum Radar — what the colours mean:
LIGHT BLUE AREA = the wave (WaveTrend), dark blue behind it = its signal line. Light crossing above dark means momentum turns up.
BARS = money flow per candle: green in, red out, violet = only futures are driving, the move runs on leverage. WHITE LINE = spot money flow; below the bars means futures are ahead.
LINES: ±50 (bold) overbought/oversold, ±100 extreme, 0 dashed.
DOTS on the wave: green = look for longs, red = look for shorts; large = higher timeframes plus money flow back the signal (≥ 60 %). Orange diamond = extreme beyond ±100, exhausted, no entry.
RAILS at +115 (short) and −115 (long): signals of the higher timeframes — 1h orange small, 4h violet, day white, week yellow large.
DIV line: divergence between wave and price (red bearish, green bullish).
COLOUR BAR at the bottom: money flow of the last closed 4h candle (green in, red out).
Closed candles only. The radar says WHEN, not WHERE.

vwapVector.text: PVSRA vector candles, anchored VWAPs with swing fan, EMAs (also from higher timeframes), Fibonacci, engulfing, naked POCs, candle POC, vector candle zones and daily open.

lsobCv.name: LSOB boxes (sweep + retest)
lsobCv.text: Liquidity sweep boxes at pivot highs/lows that exceed the previous pivot; box = whole candle, invalid when a body penetrates beyond the tolerance; signal on the first retest; pre-warn line.

Solid: how much was actually liquidated there (own recording, Binance). Red = longs (forced sells), turquoise = shorts (forced buys). ✓ confirmed, ○ empty — only for zones the price has passed. The hit rate counts passed zones in the model window. Actual is relative: Binance reports at most one liquidation per second, so dollar amounts would be too low.

A wall is a price zone with at least 2.5× the typical zone of its side AND at least 2 minutes of average turnover — "· 9 min" on the label means: that long the market would need on average to clear it. The snapshot reaches no further than ±… % — for BTC only a few hundredths of a percent.

portfolio.paareHilfe: Both exchanges only return spot history per pair. Already queried: coins in the balance, in the journal and the ten most common — add the rest here.
portfolio.nurOeffentlich: Public addresses and xpubs only — never the recovery phrase.
portfolio.keineWallets: No wallet yet. Create one and add its addresses.
portfolio.ersteAdresse: Paste an address or xpub of the {typ}
portfolio.adressePlatzhalter: zpub…, bc1q…, 0x…, r… (XRP) or Solana address
portfolio.adresseHilfe: The chain is detected automatically. Bitcoin: preferably the account xpub/zpub (Ledger Live → Account → Edit → Advanced), otherwise just that one address.
portfolio.etherscanText: Without a key the portfolio only reads the native balance on EVM networks (ETH, BNB …). A free Etherscan key adds tokens and history — one key for all networks.
portfolio.bitpandaText: Create the key under Bitpanda → Settings → API with the "Read" scope only; do not tick Trade/Earn. It is checked when saved.
portfolio.ersterAbrufText: Exchanges and wallets are being queried. Bitunix and Pionex are asked pair by pair — this takes about a minute.
portfolio.sammelText: All open items of {q} at once:
portfolio.sammelFrage: Classify all open items of {q} as "{e}"? Individual ones can be undone afterwards.
portfolio.nurHistorieText: file sources without a current balance — count for the tax years
portfolio.leerGeraeumt: Empty today — its history counts for the tax years.
portfolio.imText: For places without an API: closed accounts (Crypto.com, KuCoin), wallets without an explorer key, reconstructions. Format: ;-separated CSV with externe_id, datum_utc, ort, art, asset, menge … Do not add imported places as live wallets as well, or the balance counts twice.
portfolio.imVorhanden: already imported — only new rows are added
portfolio.imDoppelt: Rows with a known externe_id are skipped — importing again is safe.
portfolio.stRecht: Not tax advice. The figures are prepared for the tax return; your canton’s rules are binding.
portfolio.stWertschriftenErkl: Holdings per coin at the reference date across all places. Price: ESTV price list if entered — otherwise the year-end price × ECB USD/CHF on 31 Dec. Click a price to enter the value from the ESTV list (ictax.admin.ch).
portfolio.stKursAendern: Enter price from the ESTV list
portfolio.stEinkommenErkl: Staking, airdrops, rewards and inflows you classified as "income" — at their CHF value at the time of receipt. Own transfers do not count.
portfolio.stAbgaengeErkl: Sales, swaps and payments with coins. Private capital gains are tax-free; the figures serve the check for professional trading. Cost basis by FIFO across all places — an own transfer does not restart the holding period.
portfolio.stKriterienErkl: The ESTV assumes private assets if ALL five criteria are met (circular 36, applied to crypto). If one is not met, the tax authority decides case by case — that is not automatic professional trading.
portfolio.stKrit_volumen: Transaction volume at most 5× the opening assets
portfolio.stKrit_einkommen: Capital gains below 50 % of net income
portfolio.stKritHaltedauerWert: {p} % of proceeds from coins held for less than 6 months.
portfolio.stKritVolumenWert: Volume {v} = {x}× the assets at the start of the year ({a}).
portfolio.stFuturesErkl: The balance on futures exchanges at 31 Dec is wealth and belongs in the securities register. Futures gains are tax-free capital gains for private assets; losses are not deductible. Futures trading is, however, an indicator of professional trading, and its volume counts towards the transaction-volume criterion. Result and volume come from the journal (year = close date), converted at the ECB rate of the day.
portfolio.stFutEintragen: Enter value from the account statement
portfolio.stFutGrund_negativ: back-calculation negative — deposits after the reference date
portfolio.stFutGrund_vorJournal: before the first journal trade — enter the value from the statement
portfolio.stKritVolumenOhne: No opening assets known — cannot be computed.
portfolio.stKritDerivateWert: {n} futures trades in the journal this year — futures trading is not pure hedging.
portfolio.stKritDerivateKeine: No futures trades in the journal this year.
portfolio.stKritSelbst: Cannot be decided from the data — please check yourself.
portfolio.stAbweichungInfo: The sum of movements differs from the exchange balance today — a movement is missing in the history; the value is not evidenced.
portfolio.imErsetzen: Replace existing places from the file (take corrected rows). Your own classifications for these places are lost.
portfolio.ueErkl: Up to the reference date the history of the selected imported places counts; after that the app reads this address live. What is reported live replaces the import; tokens that cannot be read live (EVM without an Etherscan key) stay from the import.
portfolio.ueSchonVergeben: already handed over to another address
portfolio.ueInfo: What this address reports live replaces the import; the rest stays from the import.
portfolio.ueAlles: Balance is read live — the history here counts for the tax years.
portfolio.biAbgeleitet: Of which {v} reconstructed (Crypto.com from the Delta book and CoinTracking).
portfolio.biInfo: For information only, not for tax. EUR and USD at the ECB rate of the deposit date; futures balances at today’s rate. What went to a futures exchange as stablecoin is part of the balance there.

positionsWarnung.hinterLiq: {symbol} {seite}: stop-loss {sl} is beyond the liquidation price {liq} — the position gets liquidated before the stop triggers.
